issues.title: Plugin attempts to read memories at the wrong path
Memories deleted or rewritten without being asked (read-only questions, extraction, auto-dream)
V2 extraction: fast models answer the transcript instead of extracting, and the fork isn't sandboxed under a global allow rule
Memory frontmatter doesn't match Claude Code: `name` is a title, `type` is top-level
memory_save writes `name: undefined` into frontmatter and `MEMORY.md` index when model omits required name arg
